goal: Three continuous engineering packages with three complete outcomes each: ordinary project delivery, migration/identity closure, configuration evolution and colleague handoff.

outcomes.title: ordinary project applicability for the three delegations
outcomes.actualConsumer: main authenticated preview -> original NewWorkForm -> original Application
positive: plain Node, npm and pnpm single packages get drafts for all three kinds with project-local profile/check/criteria
declared atoms, exclusions and expiry come from the same current configuration
independentNegative: undeclared atom -> needs_input; unknown project -> forbidden
declared manager without a lockfile gets an actionable note, never a guessed install or command

outcomes.title: original project delivery and real failure recovery
positive: two registered roots: preview -> create -> fixture attempt -> check/candidate -> ready -> manual accept -> delivered
artifact bytes readable; same Work revise_work reaches revision 2 and delivers; reopen verifies both works
missing atom repaired by choosing a declared atom, then delivered; config revision change invalidates an applied draft and re-reads
independentNegative: accept not offered before readiness; cross-project candidate rejected; replay after a legal accept is stale
same commandId with a different body is refused as conflict

held.reason: In controlled fixture mode the completion contract is the product's own check-fixture-output; project settings/authorize and the project check only exist with an admitted native configuration (outside this wave's zero-native budget).
held.evidence: fail-layer-held.case.ts shows a deliberately failing project suite still delivers under the fixture check, so the layer is not claimed as tested; main/H own the real verifier.

remaining: no fake verifier or E assertion change

outcomes.title: explainable revalidation under configuration and fact change
outcomes.actualConsumer: main/F render structured reasons; previewInputs keeps its error contract
positive: one closed reason vocabulary: configuration version/schema/revision/removal, facts invalid/changed/future/expired, expiry, clock
stable content digest: re-reading unchanged bytes stays current
independentNegative: future/expired observations and invalid clocks are never current
observationComplete=false when the current facts have gaps, so 'unchanged' is not reported as complete
remaining: main keeps the fresh server clock and the registered root

outcomes.title: project re-identification on the current registration
positive: same id on a new root: changed with field-level differences
same content in a new root: current, with the root identity explicitly left to the caller
different id with identical content: reidentified with no field changes and no reuse
independentNegative: no registered root -> unbound; an authorized-root violation is an error
malformed previous facts or invalid clock refused; no root/key/grant in the report
remaining: main has not imported rebind.ts; no default migration surface

outcomes.title: history and new authorization after a non-empty backup
outcomes.actualConsumer: same ProductStore/Application; registration of the moved root through main
positive: a delivered work, its candidate and every artifact byte stay under the original project id after reopen
the moved root registers as a new id and receives its own fresh draft
independentNegative: the old draft cannot cross identities (stale facts)
rebind reports reidentified; the old result is not new permission

held.layer: A/D real bundle backup -> restore -> new authorization
held.reason: The authoritative bundle bytes belong to A/D; the J-side test reopens the same store and explicitly does not claim bundle restore.
held.next: Once A/D publish a frozen cohort, the same consumer can be pointed at the restored store without changes.

outcomes.title: capability description and version closure
outcomes.actualConsumer: CLI, main module calls and D inventories compare one identity
positive: description now includes contracts { version, apiMajor } and capabilities; supportsCapability() detects an older package
CLI --describe prints exactly the library description
independentNegative: a description without rebind yields false instead of a crash
no path, credential or authority in the description
remaining: npm pack --dry-run is a listing, not deployable-product proof

outcomes.title: versioned project configuration and daily editing
positive: J-side revalidation already treats configuration revision/schema/removal as distinct reasons, so a changed declaration invalidates old drafts
independentNegative: no hidden check registration or grant widening is performed by J

held.layer: two projects edited through the product settings then re-previewed while old contracts stay isolated
held.reason: In fixture mode the runtime normalizes every project to the fixed src/ scratch grant and derives criteria from the fixture check; ProductProjectSettings (the versioned declaration write path) is only constructed with a native configuration, which is outside the zero-native budget.
held.next: main/H can run this with an admitted native config; J's currency reasons already cover the data side.

outcomes.title: portable tool and boundary behaviour
outcomes.actualConsumer: the real CLI plus the same observer main uses
positive: roots with spaces and Chinese characters observe and preview normally
read-only metadata files are readable; new reports are 0600 and exclusive
independentNegative: permission-denied and interrupted reads now return a bounded `unreadable` refusal instead of a raw fs error (fixed this wave)
an old facts protocol is refused with exit 5; existing output files are never overwritten
remaining: package listing is not an installed-product verdict

outcomes.title: long-term hand-off on one selected runtime
outcomes.actualConsumer: same runtime: two works, a same-Work revision and a reopen
positive: two projects deliver; one work is revised to contract revision 2 and delivered again on the same runtime
closing and reopening the state shows the delivered works and their artifacts
independentNegative: stale and cross-project accepts stay refused; no fixture registry substitutes a real Work
remaining: D successor freeze and E installed verdict; cross-machine/restore/value stay separate
